name: error_recovery
description: Wraps core/recovery.py's error classification, fallback selection, and real recovery actions as CCOS capabilities. Outcome tracking routes through core/strategy_tracker.py's StrategyTracker (already used, disk-persisted) rather than core/recovery.py's own in-memory StrategySwitcher history — see error_recovery.py module docstring.

capabilities.name: coding.recovery_classify_error
capabilities.description: Classify an error message into an error type (e.g. import_error, file_not_found, test_failure)

capabilities.name: coding.recovery_get_fallback
capabilities.description: Get the best fallback recovery strategy for an error type or error message

capabilities.name: coding.recovery_execute_strategy
capabilities.description: Execute a recovery strategy's real action (pip install, search for similarly named files, create missing parent directories, check for a missing shell command, or isolate and re-run a failing pytest test)

capabilities.name: coding.recovery_record_outcome
capabilities.description: Record a recovery attempt's outcome (strategy, error type, success, duration) via the disk-persisted StrategyTracker

author: CCOS
